I have been complaining to doctors for 6 years about extreme tiredness that stole my youth, is preventing me from having a job, and generally is ruining my life. For 6 years, no one has done anything, even though I keep trying to get an investigation started.
Last week, I managed to get a blood test (after begging for one; they tried to shrug me off like 'Sometimes people just be tired 🤷🏻‍♀️'), but once again they said the results are all "satisfactory". I said "Are they, though? It says I'm borderline for most of these" and they were like 'Yeah but that's technically ok'. Like, 'technically'??? Clearly it's not okay if I feel like this all the time?
So I said "Okay, if you say my nutrients are fine, shouldn't we look at other possible reasons for my fatigue?" To which I was told to take iron tablets (I already tried that for TEN YEARS) and come back in 3 months for another blood test.
I felt the doctor was irritated by my insistence to find answers, and apathetic towards my condition, despite me pleading for help and highlighting how this unknown condition is affecting my life. My appointment was at 5.40pm; it honestly seemed like she just wanted to get me out and go home.
So around in circles we go again, I guess? Another three months of feeling awful. Another blood test. Another "everything seems fine 🤷🏻‍♀️". Is this my life? I have to spend another 60 years too exhausted to work and clean myself and be happy? I don't even know where to turn, it seems like no one cares.
What's hilarious is there was literally a 'Jess's rule' poster on the wall of the doctor's office. How ironic. I know this review is long and way too personal but I'm just begging for help at this point.
Gotta add, there's a really nice male doctor and a blood nurse that works here and they're so kind and actually seem to care. But I never end up getting an appointment with them, I always end up with someone as bored, tired, and depressed as I am.
Also, don't you dare try and say "I think this is the problem" to some of these doctors because they get so snooty, it feels like they'll actively try and prove you wrong out of spite, even if you're right.",null,[0,240]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tGVk1VdHRMWEpvYjI4eWJsUmZibkZQVFZCdFIyYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xcb74030d7d50424a!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOkFVMUttLXJob28yblRfbnFPTVBtR2c%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2tGVk1VdHRMWEpvYjI4eWJsUmZibkZQVFZCdFIyYxAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwio-NXkwLOTAxXFCXsEHX1EBAgQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwio-NXkwLOTAxXFCXsEHX1EBAgQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURUZHZDNoZlgxOWZSV2hET1Y5RE1tUTVNM3BJT1RCblIzcE1aMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpRTUVOWk1ISXRNR2gzV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2w4MmRYZExNRWhmVW5WbFdGVTNjSE55YlhwV1JtYxAB",["0x0:0xcb74030d7d50424a",null,1759415753147064,1759415753147064,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/107152193465509879267/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Graham Russell","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJYp5MzKhAIZwWQyv8qn2FcyP0lvod7DuYZLVrbjqziGQ1pLg=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/107152193465509879267?hl=en"],"107152193465509879267",null,2,3,null,[0,3,1],0,["2 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwio-NXkwLOTAxXFCXsEHX1EBAgQ7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"5 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Attended yesterday following a fall.
